title: Make a marker your buddy can find

preflight: Adult operator uses a new offline studio world, never a learner world, Realm, or shared server.
Create and hash the empty-world checkpoint; record the installed version and full client settings before capture.
Creative mode, peaceful difficulty, no entities, no resource packs or add-ons, no chat/nameplates/personal information in frame.
Confirm the two hotbar selection bindings and placement control on this exact client. Capture other inputs as separate profiles; never relabel Java screenshots.

steps.mentorNote: Name the selected slot only if needed. The learner selects it; do not touch their controls.
hints: What are you trying to change?
Point to the matching part of the picture.
Show one action in your own demo area, then let the learner do it.
steps.recovery: Pause. Keep the learner build. Help undo only the last misplaced block, or reselect the intended hotbar slot. Never restore the studio fixture over learner work.
steps.completion: Learner can select their chosen building block.
